notes: True homograph of the existing H6202 ("break the neck; break down [altars]"), identical spelling and pointing (עָרַף) -- added as ערף¹ (lower Strong's number) per the ascending-Strong's-number superscript convention; H6202 is retroactively renamed ערף² in this same batch. (H6202's own file already noted this homonym risk at its own creation time, before this sibling root existed.)
